question: Who among the following is the author of the famous classic ‘Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lewis Carroll.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lewis Carroll also named as **Charles Lutwidge Dodgson.**
 
• He was an English author, poet and mathematician .
 
• His most notable works are** Alice's adventures in Wonderland and it's sequel through the looking glass.**
 
• He is best known as the author of the children's book Alice's Adventure in wonderland (1865) and it's sequel through the looking glass (1871)
 
• He was noted for his facility with word play , logic , and fantasy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Roald Dahl** was a **British novelist** ,** short story writer , poet ,screenwriter ,and wartime fighter **pilot of Norwegian descent. 
 
• **Ruskin bond** is an **Anglo Indian Author** , his first novel ,** The room on the roof ,** was published in 1956 ,and received the** John Llewellyn Rhys** Prize in 1957. 
 
• **Ernest Hemingway** was an** American novelist, short writer and journalist **. His economical and understated style - which he termed the iceberg theory had a strong influence on 20th century fiction , while his adventurous lifestyle and public image brought him admiration from later generations.
